articles.title: Iran claims four tankers struck mines in Hormuz as strike fears grow after U.S. midterms
articles.description: Iran said four tankers struck mines in the Strait of Hormuz, while Tehran disputed a U.S. claim that key shipping lanes had been cleared.

articles.title: Bitcoin, ether and XRP selloff wipes out $1.5 billion in leveraged crypto bets
articles.description: Bets on rising prices accounted for nearly 84% of forced closures, with Binance handling almost half the total. A rebound has since started catching short sellers.

articles.title: A pharma giant is moving past one patent cliff — but another is already looming
articles.description: Disappointing data highlights Novartis' challenge to build its next generation of blockbuster medicines, following a series of clinical trial setbacks.

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Strategy eyes more Bitcoin buys as Saylor touts $30B credit capacity
articles.description: Michael Saylor says Strategy could create up to $30 billion in digital credit without new common-stock fundraising or further Bitcoin price gains, as the company plans more BTC purchases.

articles.title: North Korea’s TraderTraitor linked to $6.3B Binance hack
articles.description: TRM Labs says it has high confidence in the attribution, while ZachXBT identified stolen funds from the Binance and Bitget hacks converging at the same address.

articles.title: XRP Ledger developers tighten the rules for who can hold 'restricted' tokens
articles.description: A set of fixes would tighten who can hold permissioned tokens on the network. The XRP Ledger Foundation says no users were affected.

articles.title: Binance hack bites India's largest crypto exchange as it curbs futures trading
articles.description: CoinDCX has restricted new futures positions after Binance’s security incident disrupted a key liquidity provider. Deposits, withdrawals and customer funds remain unaffected, the exchange said.

articles.title: Binance hacker splits $1.4 billion of bitcoin into 19 wallets that no one can freeze
articles.description: All 18,270 coins sit in 19 wallets, 17 of them holding exactly 1,000 BTC each, and none has moved since Thursday night, a CoinDesk trace of the blockchain shows.

articles.title: Biggest-ever crypto hack impacts $6.3 billion as Binance works to contain fallout
articles.description: Binance estimated the impact of a security incident at $6.3 billion, with around $3 billion in crypto assets frozen, and pledged to cover all losses.

articles.title: DOJ escalates Alaska Senate lawsuit over dueling Sullivan candidacies
articles.description: Alaska's election could determine which party has a majority in the Senate. GOP Sen. Dan Sullivan faces a strong challenge from Democrat Mary Peltola.

articles.title: BOJ holds rates as underlying inflation aligns with 2% target for first time since 2013
articles.description: The BOJ declared that its underlying inflation target of 2% has been met, the first time the central bank has done so since it set the target in 2013.

articles.title: $6 billion Binance hack sends bitcoin, ether tumbling; Standard Chartered expects more pain
articles.description: Bitcoin and ether slid after a suspected $6.3 billion Binance security breach and a Polymarket exploit. Standard Chartered says crypto prices may remain under pressure before finding a base.

articles.title: Institutional crypto investors rush to pull funds from exchanges after Binance hack
articles.description: The withdrawals suggest the fallout from the multibillion-dollar breach is spreading beyond Binance.

articles.title: Binance hack could accelerate shift to DEXs: Standard Chartered
articles.description: Standard Chartered’s Geoffrey Kendrick says the breach could accelerate a shift toward decentralized trading and strengthen his case for Uniswap’s UNI token reaching $100 by 2030.

articles.title: Crypto's longtime foe, North Korea's Lazarus Group, likely behind Binance hack: blockchain sleuths
articles.description: Security researchers suggested that the hermit kingdom's Lazarus Group was behind Thursday's nearly $6 billion hack of the world's largest crypto exchange.

articles.title: Israel faces weeks of coalition haggling as Netanyahu’s party claims election 'stolen'
articles.description: Israel's election leaves the country facing weeks of coalition bargaining and an uphill battle for the opposition party to form a majority government.

articles.title: Some Polymarket user funds stolen by hackers; exchange referring matter to U.K. authorities
articles.description: The outage comes just days before the platform is expected to experience heightened trading during the U.S. midterm elections.
